messages:
Lucy: Heads-up — opened a small PR to fix the Python SDK snippet in the migration guide and a broken internal link. Need a reviewer and someone who can merge after CI. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4387 :link:
Sam: looking now, can do a quick pass for the snippet accuracy. :eyes:
Maya: I can review but I'm on oncall tilt until 11:30am PT, might be slow to respond otherwise.
Rajat: I can take merge duty if CI is green. ping me when preview is up. :+1:
docs-preview-bot: docs-preview build queued for PR #4387 — status: queued
deploy-bot: docs-preview running: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr-4387 — logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/4387/logs
Sam: small nit — the Python example uses old client import. Suggest replacing `from redwood import Client` with `from redwood_inference import RedwoodClient` (see style guide). Also linkcheck found one 404 (internal cross-ref).
Lucy: thanks Sam — I pushed a tiny correction to the import and fixed the markdown ID for the cross-ref. Can you re-check?
Sam: re-checking... looks good now. snippet compiles locally with 3.11. :white_check_mark:
docs-preview-bot: docs-preview build finished for PR #4387 — status: failed (linkcheck)
Lucy: argh — linkcheck still failing, says /guides/old-migration is 404 (I removed that page in last sprint). I'll update the cross-ref to point to /guides/migration-v2. Pushing patch in 2m.
Maya: if it stays flaky, can we merge behind a gated flag? We have a release window at 2pm PT and want docs up before then.
Rajat: my preference is merge only after green preview. I can merge as soon as we get a successful build (I won't force-merge unless toggle is approved).
Lucy: patch pushed. Requesting another preview run.
deploy-bot: docs-preview rebuild requested by Lucy for PR #4387
docs-preview-bot: docs-preview build finished for PR #4387 — status: success — preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr-4387
Sam: quick LGTM from me — snippet reads clean and link resolves.
Maya: good on my end too, merged locally with the example and lints pass.
Rajat: merging now, will monitor for any regression alerts.
Rajat: merged PR #4387 into main. :tada:
Lucy: thanks everyone — appreciated the quick turnaround. I'll add this PR to the release notes under docs fixes.
